relations.text_en: Bought its Piedmont unit's Tennessee gas business in March 2026

source.label: Spire 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: On March 31, 2026, Spire completed the acquisition of the Tennessee natural gas business of Piedmont, a wholly owned subsidiary of Duke Energy, for $2.48 billion in cash at closing, subject to customary purchase price adjustments.
